searchText: ok fair, I guess the "use EVM code to do multisends" use case is a good example of ephemeral code https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/726 ? I remember something that was simpler - just provided a bytecode for execution. Does anyone still want it? I think optimism wanted something like that a while back (maybe there was a spec?) but likely aren’t as interest now that they are going interactive proofs I had such an internal proposal within ipsilon, which is an eval with continuations. It returns whenever access-opcodes are executed and the caller can decide to supply data and resume or just abandon execution. This was the doc, updated it just now: https://notes.ethereum.org/@axic/Syj2dOkSu
